spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Preparation of States of Restraint Before the Descent of Evils

---

**¶1:** Understand also this further matter: Before these containing forms of evil were expelled and cast down from interior states of the mind, three states of confinement were first prepared and established to receive them, within which they would be restrained and held fast.

---

**¶2:** Before the great persuasion of falsity from self-love was expelled from the celestial order, Divine Providence formed a place for it within that vast expanse of natural knowledge contained by doctrinal boundaries, upon which the vessels of doctrine move, and where the fullness of truth shall [GAP-1: — the spiritual sense requires here: the completion or ultimate gathering of all genuine knowledges into their order].

---

**¶3:** Also, before the [GAP-2: — a dominant evil or monstrous falsity] was made manifest to the faculties of the mind [GAP-3: — some act of exposure or confrontation], the natural mind [GAP-4: — descended or was drawn down into] the realm of natural knowledge and its own intention gave it form; Divine Providence formed a place for it in [GAP-5: the interior region] beneath the four exalted states of celestial order, above the elevated states of the interior heavens [GAP-6: — a further specification of this intermediate region] so that [GAP-7: — it would be held within bounds]; a vast open state it excavates in the substance of evil in the midst of all the faculties. When the indestructible power of Divine Truth was sent forth against it, that power pursued it swiftly to that prepared state, struck it down, and cast it between exalted states of order into the place made ready for its confinement [GAP-8: — and that power of truth] is fixed upon it until the final consummation of all things.

---

**¶4:** Before the profane residues and corruptions of falsity from evil were purged from the regenerate mind, hells were prepared in which those corruptions would be buried until the final judgment and dissolution of the fallen order.

---

**¶5:** Before the self-willed evils rose up — those organized hosts of evil that revolted against the governing faculty both in the interior and exterior mind — they [GAP-9: — were cast] outward; and also the dominant evils in whose will it lay to tyrannize among the obscurities and darkened understandings and false reasonings and evil influences and violent temptations of the mind; for them were prepared in the outermost realm of falsity seven states of confinement — places from which they are cast into the abyss and into utter falsity [GAP-10: — and sealed there in perpetuity].

---

**¶6:** Also, before the failed and aborted spiritual conceptions [GAP-11: fell — that is, descended into] the natural mind, there was set apart [GAP-12: — a distinct state of containment]: they are gathered together and dwell within it.

---

**¶7:** Again, before the knowledges that had been set as guardians of truth perverted themselves and fell from interior states, a state of complete spiritual restraint was prepared and established for them in the deepest regions of the natural mind, below even the foundations of exalted worship.

---

**¶8:** Before the derivative falsities born of those great persuasions of evil came into existence — they who had [GAP-13: REVIEW no] awareness of spiritual good within them nor any acknowledgment of the Divine — thirty-six complete systems of false doctrine were assigned and established for them, within which the offspring of [GAP-14: REVIEW the great persuasions of evil would] persist; they who would continue to propagate falsity from one another, they who would endure through a full and complete state of spiritual duration.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Understand also this other (matter): Before these vessels were discharged and swept down from heaven, first three ditches were fashioned and constructed for them, in which they would be bound and fettered.

Before the sea giant was discharged from the sphere, the Father of Life constructed a place for [him i]n this great sea that is within the walls, whereon the ships sail, and where the fullness shall [be purified and gathered in]

Also, before the [dragon] was displayed to the worlds [and shown to] the earth [it was drawn down and f]ell to the sea and its thought shaped it, the Father of Life constructed a place for it in [the depth of the earth] below the four mountains, above the mountains of the heavens above [ ... ] that [is] a great plain it digs in Matter in the midst of the worlds. When the Adamant of Light was sent to it, he hastened after it to that place, smote it and threw it between mountains in the place made ready for it [and he] is set fast upon it till the end of the universe.
Before the waste and dirt of the darkness were swept out from creation, gehennas were constructed in which the waste might be covered till the dissolution of the universe.

Before the rebels rose up, they whose corps rebelled in the ruling-power above and below, they [who were cast] outside, and also the tyrants in whose heart it lay [to ty]rannise amongst the murk and the clouds and winds and spirits and storms; for them were constructed in the great outer sea seven hostels, places whence they are thrown into the depths and the darkness [and sealed for ever]
Also, before the abortions [fell from heaven and came down] to the earth, there was set apart [a place for them]: they are gathered in and dwell therein.
Again, before the watchers rebelled and came down from heaven, a prison was fashioned and constructed for them in the depths of the earth, below the mountains.

Before the children of the giants were born, they who had [no] knowledge of righteousness in them nor divinity, thirty-six cities were assigned and constructed for them wherein the children of [the giants would] live; they who would come to beget from each other, they who shall spend ten hundred years alive.

fills.explanation: In Manichaean cosmology the ships (Sun and Moon) sailing on the great sea purify and collect the light particles; the spiritual reading confirms "the completion or ultimate gathering of all genuine knowledges into their order," making "purified and gathered in" the standard Kephalaia eschatological formula for the fullness of light.

The creature pursued and bound between mountains by the Adamant of Light is the dragon in Manichaean cosmology; correspondentially, in Swedenborg the dragon represents monstrous falsity, which matches the spiritual reading's "dominant evil or monstrous falsity."

The spiritual reading requires "some act of exposure or confrontation" at this point; "and shown to" extends the display of the dragon from the worlds to the earth specifically, constituting a further act of exposure that precipitates the earth's descent described in GAP-4.

fills.fill: it was drawn down and f
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading states "the natural mind descended or was drawn down into the realm of natural knowledge"; in the natural register, "the earth" (= natural mind) was drawn down and fell to the sea (= natural knowledge), with "f" completing the word "fell."

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the interior region" and the Kephalaia's spatial description places the prison below the four mountains and above the heavenly mountains, corresponding to an intermediate interior zone best expressed as "the depth of the earth."

The copula "is" completes the demonstrative clause "that is a great plain it digs in Matter," identifying the region of confinement as the vast plain where the dragon excavates in the substance of darkness.

The spiritual reading identifies "that power of truth" (the Adamant of Light) as the subject of "is set fast upon it"; "and he" introduces the Adamant as the one fixed upon the dragon until the end, matching the Kephalaia's pattern of the victorious divine agent standing over the bound archon.

The spiritual reading states "were cast outward" and the surrounding syntax requires a relative clause describing the rebels; "who were cast outside" parallels the chapter's recurring pattern of entities being expelled to prepared prisons.

The spiritual reading specifies "and sealed there in perpetuity"; in the Kephalaia's register, "sealed for ever" denotes permanent confinement, completing the description of the seven hostels as places of irrevocable imprisonment.

fills.fill: fell from heaven and came down
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading requires a descent "into the natural mind"; in the Kephalaia, abortions fall from the firmament, and "fell from heaven and came down" mirrors ¶7's own phrasing "came down from heaven," maintaining the chapter's consistent vocabulary for celestial descent.

The spiritual reading identifies "a distinct state of containment" and the chapter's recurring formula is "constructed/set apart a place for X"; "a place for them" completes the pattern and leads naturally into "they are gathered in and dwell therein."

The editor's "no" is confirmed: the spiritual reading states "no awareness of spiritual good within them nor any acknowledgment of the Divine," and "no knowledge of righteousness" perfectly expresses this total absence of spiritual good in the Kephalaia's register.

The editor's "the giants would" is confirmed: the paragraph concerns "the children of the giants" throughout, and the spiritual reading's "the great persuasions of evil would persist" maps directly to "the giants would live" as the natural-plane expression of derivative falsities persisting in their assigned doctrinal systems.
